snippet.title: The Future is Now - Super Smash Bros. Crusade Remix Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Song by DJtheS.

CRUSADE REMIX IS REAL!
A hotfix has been added to Crusade Remix, please download these files!
Gamebanana Page: https://gamebanana.com/mods/687191
Mirror 1: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Dh4pZaM3XSmfrk3d3v9ntYqza1Ztp3Is/view?usp=sharing
Mirror 2: https://mega.nz/file/syQFAZwB#Rdbs6_kWr-Z_4xSm0ZAJhiW8JwRKTAR75sGmOB5ugO4

If you have any questions, come to the Crusade Remix Discord: https://discord.gg/JVW9yMXnXT
Thank you all for your support, critique and feedback!
